15: Rain can hurt people by not falling. And when it falls again, that same rain lifts those people back up. Rain does it all.
20: No one in the world can live without water. In the same way, good behaviour cannot last in the world without rain.
24: A person who controls the five senses with a strong mind, the way a hook controls an elephant, is a seed for the best world of all, freedom from being born again.
35: True goodness means living while keeping away from four things: jealousy, greed, anger and harsh words.
41: A person who truly lives family life is a steady helper on the good path for the three other kinds of people who depend on them.
43: The main duty of a family person is to take good care of these five: their ancestors who have died, the gods, guests, relatives, and themselves.
48: A family life that helps others stay on the right path, and never turns away from what is right itself, is stronger than the hard self-discipline of people who leave home to live in the forest.
63: The wise say children are their parents’ true treasure. And each child’s own worth comes to them through the things they do.
71: Is there any lock that can keep love hidden? When someone dear is suffering, the small tears of those who love them will give it away.
74: Love makes us eager to be close to others. That eagerness brings friendship, a treasure greater than anything we could go looking for.
118: Like a scale that is first set level and then weighs things exactly, a good person stays steady and does not lean to either side. This is their jewel.
119: Fair words are truly fair only when the heart is also firmly fair and does not secretly take one side.
